dataIdInfo.idPurp: Severe Bicyclist Injury Area (SBIA) is where two or more severe bicyclist injuries have occurred in close proximity such that the spacing between any two severe bicyclist injuries is no more than a ½-mile. Established the goal of eliminating all traffic deaths and serious injuries. This data supports Vision Zero by identifying areas of concern for future study or safety improvement.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: Severe Bicyclist injury crashes occurred on San Antonio roadways. One may think that these crashes would appear to be random, however, upon initial analysis, this is not the case.
